_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: J. M. Rodwell (1808-1900). The Koran, in his chronological order of the suras (1861). PD. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 6) under the coordinator's standing instruction to choose further translator shelves; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.

rodwell-koran.note: Rodwell orders the suras by his estimate of their chronology, not the traditional order; the unit id must carry the sura number, not the position.

_excluded.pg-3434: Gutenberg 3434 is the same Rodwell translation (an older file); not fetched twice.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker.
